narr: Other than a couple large hail reports from Dec 29 across Drew and Bradley Counties, there wasn't much severe weather reported across Arkansas near the end of the year, widespread rain and thunderstorms were noted on Dec 29 and again on Dec 31. Much of the heaviest rain held off until just after the new year, but portions of western and northern Arkansas picked up some heavy rain before midnight.
ev: Street flooding was reported in Little Rock.
lsr: STREET FLOODING WAS REPORTED IN THE METRO.
